name: All in one checkout page builder for woocommerce
author: Trusty Plugins

sections.description:
All in one checkout page builder for woocommerce is an easy-to-use plugin that helps you to make checkout template.

Key Features:

  • Works with Divi Builder: Easy and highly customizable.
  • Simple to Use: don’t need any technical skills to use the plugin.

Source Code

The uncompressed source code for this plugin (including JavaScript and build tools) is publicly available at:

  1. https://github.com/trustyplugins/woo-checkout-builder

Build Instructions

This plugin uses Parcel as a build tool to compile and bundle JavaScript assets.

To build the plugin from source:

  1. Clone the repository:
    git clone https://github.com/trustyplugins/woo-checkout-builder

  2. Navigate into the plugin folder:
    cd trusty-woo-checkout-builder

  3. Install the required dependencies:
    npm install

  4. Build the assets:
    npm run build

This will generate the production-ready JavaScript files in the /js and /scripts directories.
sections.installation:
1. Install The Dependencies

Before getting started, ensure you have the Woocommerce installed and activated.

2. Upload the Plugin:

  • Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • From the left-hand menu, go to Plugins > Add New.
  • After selecting the file, click Install Now.

3. Activate the Plugin:

  • Once the installation is complete, click the Activate Plugin button.

Open wordpress settings menu and find sub menu ‘Trusty Checkout’.
sections.faq:
can we add custom billing fields?

Yes you can easily add custom billing/shipping fields and rearrange them too.
